risks.title: Security considers itself insufficiently involved in the programme
risks.note: Will reports Security as actively unhappy about their level of involvement.

provenance.author: Will Brown
provenance.quote: Security is pitching a fit about not being included enough

verification.note: Proposed by Claude Tag. No person has checked it.

risks.title: Vendor certificates may not all be in hand by 23 August
risks.note: Raised as a concern by Will Brown in channel, not in a meeting. He did not say which vendors, which certificates, or what the 23rd is a deadline for, and nobody was named to own chasing them.

provenance.author: Will Brown
provenance.quote: I'm worried that we can't get certificates from all the involved vendors by the 23rd.

verification.note: Proposed by Claude Tag. No person has checked it.

risks.title: Frostbite on Will Brown's thumb may leave him unable to type by 22 September
risks.note: Raised by Will Brown in channel. He named himself owner and called it minor, recorded as severity Y.

provenance.author: Will Brown
provenance.quote: Some risk that the frostbite on my thumb will render me incapable of typing by 9/22.

verification.note: Proposed by Claude Tag. No person has checked it.
